summary: Verified the deeply-personalized trust-draft AI explanation feature end-to-end for Michael Thompson case (8eb42bd3). Backend: 8/8 pytest cases passed in /app/backend/tests/test_trust_draft_personalization.py — from-trust-draft returns personalized=true with all 7 personal fields (greeting/grantor_intro/trustee_roles/beneficiaries/assets_plain/trust_type_meaning/next_steps) plus all 5 legacy compat fields; content contains 'Michael', 'Sarah', 'James', '60%', '40%', 'Fort Lauderdale', 'Fidelity' and none of the banned jargon ('per stirpes','settlor','corpus','in terrorem'); import is idempotent (already_imported=true on repeat); regenerate on trust_draft source stays personalized; regular non-trust-draft admin doc upload still produces legacy explanation (personalized is not true); client GET /trust-cases/{id}/trust-draft-explanation requires auth (401 anon) and returns 404 with 'not been generated' when no draft doc. Frontend: /portal/trust-preview/8eb42bd3 renders trust-preview-side-by-side=1 with preview-viewer=1 (LEFT watermarked PDF) + trust-draft-explanation-panel=1 (RIGHT), personalized-badge shows 'Personalized for Michael', all 7 expl-* data-testids present, body text contains all expected names/percentages/address/institution.

minor.issue: Legacy branch of doc_explainer.generate_explanation omits the 'personalized' key from the response rather than setting it to False. Frontend guards on truthy so no user-visible impact, but the doc string in doc_explainer.py implies both branches return the flag. Cosmetic only.

action_items: Optional: in doc_explainer.generate_explanation legacy branch, add 'personalized': False to the returned dict for consistency with the personalized branch.
critical_code_review_comments: _build_case_context (server.py:2841) reads case fields safely with `or []`/`or ''` defaults — good defensive default so LLM prompt never crashes on partial intakes.
GET /trust-cases/{id}/trust-draft-explanation (server.py:2860) correctly filters is_deleted docs and uses source=='trust_draft' as the marker; 404 detail string is user-friendly.

from-trust-draft idempotency key is (source=='trust_draft' AND source_storage_path==draft.storage_path AND not is_deleted). Works, but if the admin re-uploads a new trust_draft version the OLD explanation stays; regenerate endpoint is the intended path — worth documenting in the admin UI.
Personalized generation takes ~30s per call and blocks the request thread — acceptable for admin action but if this is ever called from a client-facing path it should be moved to a background task.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all data-testids + personalization content verified via Playwright)

Personalized LLM call takes ~30s so bump timeouts if adding new content tests.
rca of the issue: Not a bug — feature verification. All acceptance criteria from the review_request met.
